---
sidebar: false
title: "Contact"
description: "How to report an error or ask a question."
---

The easiest way to reach me about this blog, the tools, or the ThSQCA package is to open an issue on GitHub:

- [ThSQCA package issues](https://github.com/im-research-yt/ThSQCA/issues): bugs and questions about the R package
- [Blog and tools issues](https://github.com/im-research-yt/im-research-yt.github.io/issues): errors in posts, and questions about the tools

When you report a problem, please include what you did, what you expected, and what you saw (the text on the screen is best). Please do not send confidential data.
